from.docs:
**int**: The index of the first LED to address in the segment. Counting starts with 0, so first LED is 0.

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the addressable light to be controlled by this segment.

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*

reversed.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to reverse the order of LEDs in this segment. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*

single_light_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of a single addressable or non-addressable light. If an addressable light is specified, it will be treated as a single light in the partition.

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*

to.docs:
**int**: The index of the last LED to address in this segment.

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*

segments.docs:
**list**: A list of segments included in this partition. *For addressable segments:*

*See also: [Light Partition](https://esphome.io/components/light/partition#configuration-variables)*
